Privacy Policy

The short version

PakToolkit tools run in your browser. We do not upload, receive, store or sell your files or the numbers you enter into calculators. There are no user accounts on PakToolkit.

Your files and inputs

Images, PDFs and documents you open in a tool are processed locally on your device by JavaScript in the page. They are never transmitted to us or to any third party by the tools themselves. Closing the tab removes everything.

What the website itself loads

PakToolkit pages are static files. PDF tools load open-source libraries (pdf-lib and pdf.js) from a public CDN (jsDelivr) only when you use those tools; those libraries run locally in your browser. Standard web hosting logs (such as IP address and page requested) may be kept by the hosting provider for security and are not used to identify individual tool usage.

Cookies and analytics

PakToolkit does not set advertising cookies of its own. If privacy-friendly analytics are added in future, this policy will be updated here first.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be published on this page. Questions about privacy can be sent via the Contact page.

PakToolkit — free online tools for Pakistan. Every tool runs in your browser; your files never leave your device.
